connect.title: Fanå'gue gi LinkedIn
connect.intro: Fanhålom gi i LinkedIn account ni' ha maneha i anunsio-mu siha. Leadrat ha taitai ha' i kuenta-mu siha, Lead Gen Form yan i estadistika siha put i anunsio siha, yan ha na'hanao i konbetsasion siha ni' un na'lå'la'.
connect.need1: Un rol gi i LinkedIn ad account (Viewer pat mas takhilo').
connect.need2: Un puesto gi i pahina ni' ma'a'atan gi i kompaniha (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator pat Analyst) - LinkedIn ha nisisita na u ma'a'atan i manma'a'atan.
connect.need3: Un kuestion put numeron tilifon gi i Lead Gen Forms mu - ti siña ma addåpta i lead siha ni' taya' numeron tilifon-niha.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Sangåni LinkedIn hayi gi i manma'gås-ña manma'gås-ñiha. Yanggen i LinkedIn lead ha håtsa i estao ni' un ayek gi papa', ha ripot Leadrat gi LinkedIn , ya i ripot-mu gi i kinampanya ha na'annok i kualidåt i lead ya siña ha sodda' mas taotao taiguihi i mas maolek na lead- LinkedIn . I LinkedIn lead ID ha' yan i one-way hash gi i email ha' ma na'hanao.
